description: Major Traffic Generators is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. The locations of major generators were identified from listed data holdings and located using ESRI base map imagery at a scale of 1:10,000. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Major Traffic Generators, Rail, California, Facilities, Freight, Transportation, CAOpenData, California Department of Transportation. The bounding box given is -122.4168,32.5719,-117.0685,40.5380. The hub shows 2024-04-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is This dataset is for public use.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
